domain_restrictions: j is an integer satisfying 0 <= j <= n minus 1 (so j depends on n)
t is a real satisfying 0 <= t and t < 1
G_{n,j}(t) and G_{n,j}(0) are defined and comparable (assumed real-valued or at least ordered)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all positive integers n, for all integers j with 0 <= j <= n minus 1, and for all real numbers t with 0 <= t < 1, the value G_{n,j}(t) is less than or equal to G_{n,j}(0).
quantifier_order: for all j (integer with 0 <= j <= n - 1)
